description: This file contains unit tests for ensuring that legacy non-throwing FileHandle read API usage has been eliminated in the source code. It scans the project's source files to detect any usage of deprecated FileHandle methods such as readDataToEndOfFile() or accessing .availableData.

classes.name: FileHandleLegacyAPIGuardTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying that legacy FileHandle APIs are not used in the source code files.

methods.name: sources avoid legacy non throwing file handle read AP is
methods.description: Main test method that locates all Swift source files under the 'Sources' directory, reads their contents, strips comments and strings, and searches for deprecated FileHandle API usage.

methods.name: swiftFiles
methods.description: Utility method to recursively find all `.swift` files under a given directory URL.

methods.name: stripCommentsAndStrings
methods.description: Private method that removes comments and string literals from source code to prevent false positives when searching for legacy API usage.
